concept.interaction: Wiggle and coil the nine-body creature by hand; squeeze both face tabs and exchange happy, sleepy and angry expressions. First print and gently release the three-cell hinge coupon (coupon_pin and its three receiver variants) to check the clearance. Test full-size spare faces against the head before use.
risks: Physical motion, print release, durability and human response are unverified.
Operator disabled motion checks; no sweep, animation or motion review is authorized.
Open C bearing and neighboring bodies require exact CAD collision and print checks; design yaw is a target.
concept.signature_interaction: A coilable gilled dragon changes its mood with a fingertip face exchange.
source_adjustments: Horns moved toX24.1 with1.85mm base radius to clear face; head shell extendsX26.
Head retaining grooves localized toX8.75..12; front cheeks removed aheadX9 to eliminate thin lips.
Male pin bottom relief rises0.8 for0.4 radial offset; body2 relief rises0.8 following numeric overhang failures.
Adjacent receiver envelope radius7.85 cut from body without altering printed joint architecture.
Optional extra facecoupon omitted; full-size spare plates support face fit trials. User-required hinge coupon preserved.
concept.summary: An original mint axolotl-dragon with coral gill fans, eight bed-rooted captive hinges, a segmented tail and three cream snap-on faces.
concept.title: Mintfin
